name: Select
purpose: Single choice from a list, with the current value on the trigger. Replaces the filter field menu button (sort mode and date range). A's MenuTrigger field look and B's Select are merged here.
base: Radix Select (shadcn Select); trigger styled as a neutral Button field

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called when the user picks an item. Sort keeps the current direction; the caller handles that.

props.name: options
props.type: { value: string; label: string; icon?: IconName }[]
props.description: Sort: Manual, Date created, Date updated, Alphabetical, Done last. Date range: Any time, Last 24 hours, Last 7 days, Last 30 days, Custom…

props.name: leadingIcon
props.description: Trigger glyph: drag_indicator for sort, schedule for date range.

props.name: fullWidth
props.description: Default true. The field fills the panel width.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Accessible name for the field (for example 'Sort').

states: open (listbox shown; current item marked with a check icon)
role: combobox on the trigger; listbox with option items on the content (Radix Select)
keyboard: Enter, Space or ArrowDown opens. ArrowUp and ArrowDown move the highlight, Enter selects, Escape closes and returns focus to the trigger. Type-ahead jumps to an option by its first letters.
platform: Same on both. Date range Custom… opens the same custom-range control on both (assumption); the custom range is not recorded.
open: (1) The filter field moves from a context menu in the reference to a Select; confirm. (2) Trigger height: 26px (A, measured) against 24.5px (B's fold). 26px kept; confirm. (3) Trigger type: 12.5px/18.75px weight 500 (A) against Button md 12px weight 600 (B). The Select keeps its own trigger type. (4) Custom… needs its own sheet or dialog; not recorded. (5) Shared with the form Select in another family; this entry specifies only the trigger look.
